{{Top|leg}}
'''Atmosphere shielding''' was used on tall [[Skyscraper/Legends|skyscrapers]] like the [[Royal Galaxy Hotel]] on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. It allowed individuals on the roof of the building to breathe as the height of the building pushed beyond the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="SF">{{JournalCite|12|Small Favors}}</ref>
